##### Project general facts

Il Vento by Kora Properties offers a reimagined vision of luxury coastal living, defined by timeless Italian design from Pininfarina Architecture. The project stands as a striking symbol of elegance, blending serene sophistication with an atmosphere inspired by a summer getaway. With its harmonious lines, maritime influences, and world-class aesthetics, Il Vento creates a living experience that is both exclusive and deeply connected to the sea.

Residents are welcomed into a resort-style environment where every sunrise becomes a private masterpiece. The tower grants unparalleled views of the marina and Dubai’s iconic skyline, offering a lifestyle immersed in natural beauty and urban vibrancy. Its prime location in Dubai Maritime City places owners at the heart of a dynamic new sailing and cruise destination, surrounded by premier dining, leisure, and cultural attractions.

The community is enhanced by thoughtfully curated facilities designed for comfort and wellbeing. From elegant arrival lounges and a grand lobby to scenic promenades, waterfront walkways, and access to yacht berths, Il Vento provides an everyday sense of exclusivity. Leisure areas, relaxation zones, and wellness-oriented spaces further elevate the seaside living experience.

Inside each residence, spacious layouts meet refined modern taste. Interiors are crafted to evoke calm and sophistication, complemented by stylish finishes and a well-designed kitchen that supports both everyday living and hosting. Every home is positioned to embrace its own breathtaking sea view, creating an effortless fusion of comfort, elegance, and coastal charm.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Maritime City is a dynamic and specialized community at the core of Dubai, dedicated to serving the maritime industry. As a comprehensive maritime hub, it offers a full spectrum of infrastructure, services, and facilities that support shipbuilding, maintenance, and a wide range of marine-related activities.

The area is purposefully designed to accommodate maritime businesses and professionals, featuring advanced shipyards, dry docks, and zones for maritime services and marine equipment suppliers. It also hosts educational and training institutions focused on the maritime field, creating a well-rounded ecosystem for industry growth and innovation.

Strategically located near Dubai’s key ports and transport networks, Dubai Maritime City provides excellent connectivity to international trade routes. This advantageous positioning ensures efficient logistics, easy access for businesses and residents, and strengthens its role as a vital link in the global maritime chain.
